acceptanceCriteria: criterion-binding capture --help and verify --help return read-only OK with command-specific usage, without reading stdin or the store.
TestCALV0047_AllCommandHelpIsReadOnly passes on main; malformed non-help criterion-binding invocations keep their existing refusals.
body: Observed 2026-10-01 on origin/main cf4c8a39 (after PR #416 merged criterion-binding verbs onto the #422 help work in cf61ee63). `GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 ./internal/tasks/cli/ -run TestCALV0047_AllCommandHelpIsReadOnly` fails: `criterion-binding verify --help` returns outcome ERROR with warning `verify consumes only canonical capture stdin` (capture --help fails likewise). Expected: read-only OK with command-specific usage per CAL-V0-047. Actual: the verb reads stdin/validates before the help intercept. Reproduced in a clean worktree at cf4c8a39 (Go 1.27.1, darwin). Related: V1-0604 (issue 422). Found while building issue 431 (dispatch), whose own help paths pass.
